purpose: Teach: 思想家/松山/結城/侍/みえる/回戦/移さ/舞台裏

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療、本気で、絶対、思想家、絶対、影響、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、考えております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Ren, I want you to know how much your thoughtfulness means to our medical team. We're genuinely grateful for your perspective.
lines.style: Steady and measured. Warm regard in the opening. Deliberate, unhurried pacing. Let sincerity sit without performance. Slight downward inflection at the end—not a question, a statement of care.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、本気で、絶対、松山、絶対、にも、絶対、分院、絶対、お持ちですよね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Your hospital has a branch in Matsuyama, doesn't it, Doctor? I've been curious about that.
lines.style: Genuinely inquisitive, leaning forward slightly in the voice. Respectful but not deferential. Light, open tone. Finishing with quiet interest rather than demand.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。本気で、絶対、結城、絶対、診療所、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、応援、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, we do. The Yuki clinic team there does excellent work—I'm quite proud of what they've accomplished together.
lines.style: Informative without being lecturing. Warm note of pride on the clinic name. Clear, measured pace. Matter-of-fact but genuinely pleased. Settling into the answer like a fact she's comfortable with.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本気で、絶対、侍、絶対、医、絶対、ドラマ、絶対、貴院、絶対、ご覧になりましたか?先生、本気for、感謝
lines.en: Have you seen that samurai-doctor drama? I was wondering if your hospital was involved in it at all.
lines.style: Light, genuine curiosity. Slightly tentative—testing whether the topic is welcome. Conversational, not performing. Hopeful lilt on the question without being pushy.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんの症状、本気で、絶対、みえる、絶対、化、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、努めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, I have. We did consult on it—making sure the medical details were accurate matters to us. My team took that responsibility seriously.
lines.style: Patient, matter-of-fact. Slight emphasis on 'accurately' with quiet pride. Unhurried delivery. Speaking of her team's work with understated confidence. No defensiveness, just fact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、本気で、絶対、第一、絶対、回戦、絶対、の、絶対、医療調査、絶対、すばらしい結果、絶対、ですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I heard your first round of quality assessments came back really strong. That must have been encouraging.
lines.style: Appreciative and reflective. Genuine admiration without flattery. Measured pace. Thoughtful pause before the observation, like he's considered it carefully. Warm respect underneath.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。患者さんを、本気で、絶対、移さ、絶対、れる前に、絶対、医療チーム、絶対、確認します、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. We verify everything thoroughly before any patient care decisions are finalized. It's not something we take lightly.
lines.style: Serious but not stern. Protective undertone when mentioning patient care. Clear, decisive pace. Warm but resolute—this is non-negotiable. Slight weight on 'thoroughly.'

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 手術の、本気で、絶対、舞台裏、絶対、貴院、絶対、ドキュメンタリー、絶対、撮影、絶対、ご許可されたんですね、先生、本気で、感謝
lines.en: I was impressed to hear you gave permission for that documentary about the surgery process. That took real courage.
lines.style: Genuine respect, appreciative tone. Thoughtful delivery—he's considering what that permission means. Warm, not gushy. Slight pause before 'courage' to let the weight settle. Ending with quiet admiration.
